title: Scarlet Wraithblade - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Scarlet Wraithblade trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Scarlet Wraithblade phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable, because she is optional. Kill her before leaving the opening region - the roadmap's first warning is exactly this fight.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 32 of 36 on the list - before it The Axe's Grudge · after it A Thousand Cups Drained. It is missable, and the checklist of everything that expires is on the guide. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
